name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the FreeCAD MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

host.title: FreeCAD host
host.description: The address or hostname of the machine running FreeCAD (127.0.0.1 by default). This machine includes localhost, ::1, and 127.x.x.x. For another host, also set Bearer token and TLS certificate file (PEM) below.

port.title: FreeCAD MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the port of the entry you connect to in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge → Listen addresses. Extension 0.1.27.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: On this machine, optional: the extension sends the token from the file FreeCAD writes at the first start. A paste of at least 32 characters replaces that token for every client, and a shorter one is ignored. For another host, required: the pasted token is used by the extension only.

tls_cert_file.title: TLS certificate file (PEM)
tls_cert_file.description: Used for another host only, where it is required. Set this to a copy of FreeCAD's certificate file, not the private key, so the extension connects over HTTPS and trusts only that certificate. On this machine the extension reads serving-cert.pem beside the token file, and uses HTTPS only when that file is present.
